north.name: Northern circuit
north.season: June to October for the dry season; late January to February for calving in the southern Serengeti.
north.blurb: The classic route: Tarangire, Lake Manyara, Ngorongoro and the Serengeti, with Kilimanjaro at the eastern end.

south.name: Southern circuit
south.season: June to October. Roads and airstrips in Ruaha and Nyerere are at their best from July.
south.blurb: Ruaha, Nyerere (Selous), Mikumi and Udzungwa — bigger, wilder and far quieter than the north.

west.name: Western parks
west.season: July to October for Katavi and for chimp trekking on Lake Tanganyika.
west.blurb: Chimpanzees at Gombe and Mahale, and the remote floodplains of Katavi. Fly-in territory.

lake.name: Lake Victoria zone
lake.season: June to October; the western Serengeti corridor is busiest with the migration in May to July.
lake.blurb: Rubondo Island, the western Serengeti, and the towns and islands of Africa's largest lake.

coast.name: Swahili coast
coast.season: June to October and December to February. Avoid the long rains, March to May.
coast.blurb: Dar es Salaam, Bagamoyo, Saadani, Mafia Island and the Usambara hills behind Tanga.

zanz.name: Zanzibar & Pemba
zanz.season: June to October and December to February; Pemba diving is clearest from October to February.
zanz.blurb: Stone Town, the northern and eastern beaches of Unguja, and the reefs and forests of Pemba.

central.name: Central highlands
central.season: Year-round; the rock-art sites are easiest to reach in the dry season, June to October.
central.blurb: The capital, Kondoa rock art and the granite country between the northern and southern circuits.

regions.name: Arusha
highlights: Ngorongoro Conservation Area and the Crater
Arusha National Park and Mount Meru
Lake Natron and Ol Doinyo Lengai
regions.gateway: Kilimanjaro International (JRO); Arusha Airport (ARK) for light aircraft
regions.note: Safari capital of the north — most itineraries start and end here.

regions.name: Dar es Salaam
highlights: City markets, National Museum, Kivukoni fish market
regions.note: Main international gateway for the south and coast.

regions.name: Dodoma
regions.note: On the road between Arusha and Iringa.

regions.name: Geita
regions.note: Rubondo: forest, chimps, fishing and birds.

regions.name: Iringa
regions.note: Ruaha: lions, wild dogs, kudu; June to October.

regions.name: Kagera
regions.note: Newest national parks, still little visited.

regions.name: Pemba North
regions.note: Lush, hilly and almost untouristed.

regions.name: Zanzibar North
regions.note: Best swimming beaches — small tidal range.

regions.name: Katavi
highlights: Lake Katavi and the Katuma floodplain
regions.gateway: Mpanda (NPY) and the Ikuu airstrip, charters from Arusha
regions.note: Hippos and buffalo herds; very few visitors.

regions.name: Kigoma
regions.note: Chimp trekking best July to October.

regions.name: Kilimanjaro
regions.note: Climbing seasons: January to March and June to October.

regions.name: Pemba South
regions.note: Some of East Africa's best drift diving.

regions.name: Zanzibar South
regions.note: Kitesurfing at Paje, June to September and December to February.

regions.name: Lindi
regions.note: Medieval Swahili ruins on the coast.

regions.name: Manyara
regions.gateway: JRO; Lake Manyara and Kuro airstrips
regions.note: Tarangire is best for elephants in the dry season.

regions.name: Mara
highlights: Serengeti (north) and the Mara River crossings
regions.note: River crossings usually July to October.

regions.name: Mbeya

stats.note: Includes the districts that became Songwe Region in 2016.

regions.note: Highland base for the far south.

regions.name: Zanzibar Urban West
regions.note: Arrival point and cultural heart of Zanzibar.

regions.name: Morogoro
regions.gateway: Dar es Salaam (DAR) by road; Mikumi airstrip
regions.note: Mikumi is the easiest park to reach from Dar.

regions.name: Mtwara
regions.note: Diving and Makonde carving country.

regions.name: Mwanza
regions.note: Main gateway for the western Serengeti.

regions.name: Njombe
highlights: Kitulo National Park — the "Garden of God"
regions.note: Orchids and wildflowers December to April.

regions.name: Pwani
regions.note: Whale sharks off Mafia, October to March.

regions.name: Rukwa
regions.note: Off-the-map; combine with Katavi.

regions.name: Ruvuma
regions.note: Quiet lake beaches, road access from Mbeya.

regions.name: Shinyanga
highlights: Transit between Mwanza and the western parks
regions.note: Mostly a road-transit region.

regions.name: Simiyu
regions.note: Migration passes through May to July.

regions.name: Singida
regions.gateway: By road from Dodoma or Arusha
regions.note: Transit region with striking scenery.

regions.name: Songwe
regions.note: Gateway to Zambia and Malawi.

regions.name: Tabora
regions.note: History of the Arab caravan route.

regions.name: Tanga
highlights: Amani Nature Reserve and the Usambaras
regions.note: Hill walking and old Swahili coast.
